about: Hand-written definitions of the expeditions. Everything here is either a pointer into the graph (event names as the claims write them, count-check keys), a gazetteer point with its source, a short name or date phrase copied from the text (allowed by the licence note in ontology/corpus/ibn-hisham-full.ttl), or a question. No fact is asserted here that the graph or the text does not carry. English renderings of Arabic phrases are AI drafts, unreviewed (maintainer answer S5).

expeditions.title: The crossing to Abyssinia
events: The migration to Abyssinia and the Negus's protection
expeditions.no_date_note: The text gives no date for the emigration, so no sky is drawn. Drawing one would need a date the text does not give.
notice: The text gives no date here. What would you need before you could draw the sky of that crossing?
Makkah to this point is a long way. Which parts of that distance are known, and which are only computed?

expeditions.title: The night at al-ʿAqaba

date.text_en: on the middle one of the days of tashrīq
date.find: وواعدنا رسول الله صلى الله ~~عليه وسلم بالعقبة من أوسط أيام التشريق
date.claim_note: In the passage, not yet extracted as a dated claim.

moment.text_en: when a third of the night had passed, we slipped out of our camp

notice: They slipped out of the camp in secret. Would the moon have helped them hide, or given them away? Guess, then slide the time.
Minā and Makkah are both in view. How far did they walk that night?

events: The Hijra of the Prophet ﷺ to Madinah

route.find: فلما خرج بهما دليلهما عبد الله بن أرقط

stages.note: the town's point; its lower part is not located

Thaniyyat al-ʿĀʾir, to the right of Rakūba

notice: The text names every stage of the road. How many of them do you think anyone can still place on a map? Guess before you look.
They arrived in the forenoon heat. Slide the time: when is the sun nearly at its height here?

expeditions.title: The eve of Badr

date.text_ar: يوم الجمعة صبيحة سبع عشرة من شهر رمضان
date.text_en: on Friday, the morning of the seventeenth of Ramaḍān
date.find: فكانت وقعة بدر يوم الجمعة صبيحة سبع عشرة من شهر رمضان

notice: Before you move the time: on the night before the seventeenth of a lunar month, when do you expect the moon to rise?
Madinah and Makkah both lie outside this valley. Which way would each side have come from?
